The vendor directly providing the software platform at **later.com** is **Victory Square Media Inc. d/b/a Later** (as part of **Mavrck LLC d/b/a Later**).

### Evidence
* **Terms of Service:**
  > *"These Social Media Management Solution Terms of Service ('Terms') exclusively govern your relationship with Victory Square Media Inc. dba Later ('Later', 'we', 'us' or 'our') and your use of the following Later websites, products and services: https://www.later.com website, https://www.latergram.me/ website, https://www.lat.gr/ website, https://linkin.bio/ website, https://app.later.com... (collectively, the Later websites, products, and services are the 'Social Media Management Solution')."*
* **Global Privacy Notice:**
  > *"Later's social media and marketing technology and services are provided by Mavrck LLC d.b.a. Later (operating Later Influence and Later Social Enterprise), and/or through our group companies such as MyFavoriteThings, Inc. d.b.a. Mavely... and Victory Square Media, Inc. (Later Social and Link in Bio)."*
